verdict.rationale: Jev's own Playground lets a user paste their data as state and get AI-generated typed answers: Noul yes/no probabilities, Choice selections and Scores with confidence. That is in-product AI evaluation of the user's data, but it answers questions the user poses rather than surfacing open-ended insights or suggestions. Missing for 10: proactive or open-ended insight and suggestion generation, an in-product analytics or insights surface beyond the question-answer Playground, and hands-on corroboration of Playground use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Paste any text as the state.
Send state and typed questions; get structured answers your code can use directly.
A Noul question asks the TypeSafe model to evaluate a yes/no question and return the probability that the answer is yes.
The answer includes the selected option, a probability for each option, and confidence.
